visual_direction: Cataclysm 1.0 CHARACTER-ONLY VISUAL UPGRADE. Preserve white cat identity, coral scarf, dual hand-held pistols and existing gameplay. Replace the visually two-pose mirrored walking cycle with a genuine fluid 24-pose run, including distinct contact/down/passing/up phases, alternating planted feet and knee bend, identifiable overlapping arm/pistol actions, weight transfer, natural head counter-motion, tail and scarf follow-through. Run must have >=8 non-mirrored silhouette families. Attack has anticipation, alternating recoil, muzzle flashes and recovery, not a static shooting pose. Idle breath/blink/tail, hit recoil/stagger/recover, feral aggressive silhouette and adrenaline fast run-and-gun need visibly different pose choreography, NOT merely recolors or phase shifts. At native mobile game size visually compelling, high-contrast, legible, polished intentional game pixel-art with real volumes and shading. Draw 24 meaningfully interpolated frames per state without repeating two flips or palette-only effects; retain version 1.0. PRIOR ATTEMPT WAS REJECTED by real visual QA: only 2-3 perceived mirrored poses even though alpha silhouette hashes counted 24; fix actual recognizably distinct full-body key poses, recoil and anatomical joints. The AI art director must approve the final playable result or no release.
